bloom-bloom:lever:176ee237-ac10-418b-97e.title: Logistics Coordinator | Poppy & Peonies
bloom-bloom:lever:176ee237-ac10-418b-97e.description: Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Logistics Coordinator to join their team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity! -------- Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies. At Poppy & Peonies, we’re a fun and energetic brand that believes style and function should always go hand-in-hand. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that make life a little easier and literally lighten the load. Building Poppy & Peonies has been an incredible adventure. It all started when my daughter Poppy was born, and I found that my accessories no longer fit my new life as a mom. I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool but also had functionality. When I couldn’t find them, I decided to create them myself. And so, in 2015, Poppy & Peonies was born. We’ve come a long way since then—from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with exciting influencers and brands. It hasn’t always been smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported! We believe in our responsibility to care for the environment and are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet and the animals that live on it. That’s why all of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste. We are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable, reducing our carbon footprint. As our Logistics Coordinator, you will support the smooth movement of product from our suppliers to our third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse and ultimately to our customers across Canada and the U.S. You will play a key role in coordinating shipments, maintaining accurate records, and supporting communication between internal teams, manufacturers, freight partners, and our 3PL provider. This role is ideal for someone highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to build a career in operations at a fast-growing fashion brand. You will help ensure that the right products arrive at the right place at the right time, supporting inventory accuracy, on-time fulfillment, and an exceptional customer experience. This is a hands-on, entry-level role with strong exposure to 3PL operations, supply chain coordination, and cross-border logistics. Does this sound like you? Do you love organizing details and making sure nothing slips through the cracks? Are you excited by the idea of keeping products moving smoothly from warehouse to customer? Do you enjoy working with different teams and external partners to solve problems? Are you someone who stays calm, organized, and communicative in a fast-paced environment? If you answered yes, yes, and yes, we would love to hear from you!

cagents-cagents:lever:19882404-3327-4e1c.description: THIS IS NOT A DATA ENGINEERING RELATED POSITION CAI seeks Mechanical Commissioning Engineers, Minimum of two years' experience in Data Center Commissioning to support development and execution of all mechanical aspects of commissioning projects. Position Description: This position supports development and execution of all mechanical aspects of assigned commissioning projects from initial engagement, design reviews, checklists, safety support, script development, vendor coordination, testing and report development through turn over to the client. The Mechanical Commissioning Engineer will support the development of the mechanical test schedule, finalize mechanical test procedures, review project submittals for consistency with the design intent, basis of design and the owner’s project requirements, and maintain project cadence for the mechanical systems testing and associated Building Automation Systems. The Mechanical Commissioning Engineer is to support the planning and execution of commissioning for the mechanical infrastructure of the mission critical facility. They will be expected to execute against the project schedule through the coordination of contractors and/or vendors to complete the desired mechanical systems testing. CAI DC Mechanical Commissioning Engineer will be exposed to cutting edge technologies in the Hyperscale and other spaces. You will have an opportunity to work with recognized subject matter experts allowing YOU to be a key player in bringing data technologies to market. As part of our company culture, we invest in YOUR future, and commit to hands on certifications as well as professional training. Our collaborative culture ensures that our customers benefit from exemplary work across our entire range of professional services. Responsibilities: Support and contribute to all aspects of safety for all mechanical tests. Support complete commissioning and performance acceptance testing of the mechanical infrastructure systems. Development of all mechanical test procedures, MOPS, SOO’s and checklists. QA/QC of all mechanical test procedures. Provide input and insight to the overall commissioning plan. Develop reports for the mechanical testing and contribute to a daily report to the Commissioning Project Manager. Attend and be an active participant of customer equipment Factory Witness Test Assist with vendor coordination and management. Perform equipment inspection to ensure build adherence to vendor submittal. Provide test documentation that equipment is delivered, installed, and tested correctly and set to function properly for the customer. Support and perform design specification review, manufacturer submittals, one line drawing sets, and project schedule documentation. Ensure safe work practices are followed by the commissioning team and customer site. Engage with customers and vendors to ensure positive experience, goals achievement, and schedule adherence. Provide daily status reports for mechanical commissioning team status. Conduct facility walk downs, turnover, and punch list reviews. General understanding of LEED specifications and requirements. Look for new opportunities for CAI to provide service and value to customer. Duties may be increased as experience and skill allow. Requirements include: Position Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience Minimum of 2 years Data Center Commissioning experience. Knowledge of OSHA safety requirements. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, P&ID’s and specifications. Knowledge of mission critical design concepts. Knowledge of various Building Automation/Monitoring Systems (BAS/BMS), Air Handlers, Humidifiers, Variable Refrigerant Flow, Computer Room Air Conditioners/Handlers (CRAC/CRAH), Evaporators, Adiabatic Coolers, Pressure/Temperature/Humidity

flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:410f.title: AI Adoption & Enablement Specialist
flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:410f.description: At Flynn, it's not just a job, it's a career Before You Read Further This role is on-site in Mississauga, five days a week.Not hybrid. Not flexible on that point. We are saying it first because the job is about getting technology to land with people where they actually work: at desks in our offices, and in our shops and on job sites. That is hard to do from a distance, and we would rather let you know now than three interviews in. The Job Flynn installs and services roofing, glazing and architectural metals across North America. Many of our people do not sit at a desk. We are rolling AI out across the business right now. Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot are the tools. An AI Steering Committee and an AI Tools Policy are in place; the rest of the governance is being built as we go. This role exists because a rollout is not a license purchase. We need someone whose whole job is getting that capability into people’s hands and genuinely used: a project coordinator, a shop foreman, a service dispatcher opening it on a Tuesday morning because it saves them an hour. Most of that is enablement. But not all of it. As the rollout reaches people, the requests start: someone wants a tool for a specific job, a team thinks AI could solve something. You will be the person those land with. You will take them in, work out how each one fits our existing frameworks and the tools we already have, decide what is genuinely worth doing, and then help build the ones that are. So, there is real administration here, and real building. What there is not, is a job that stops at "the licenses are assigned." You will sit in IT and report directly to our VP of Information Technology. No layers between you and the person who owns this. What we offer: Funded training and development program Subsidized in-house cafeteria and gym Dental and supplemental medical plan RRSP contributions Employee and Family Assistance Program Free parking and EV Charging facility Family Events and Flynn Fest Sports Sponsorship Program Rogers Preferred Program Perkopolis Retailer Discounts What You Will Actually Do Get the tools into people’s hands. Plan and run the rollout, group by group: who gets access when, what they need to know first, and what has to be true before you move to the next group.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:3f314277-.description: ABOUT US: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Senior Data Analytics Specialist, you'll be a key member of the Marketing Analytics and Data Science team based in Prague, partnering with stakeholders across our global consumer brands, including Norton, Avast and LifeLock. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Data Analytics, you'll help drive data-informed marketing decisions by delivering insightful analysis, performance reporting and scalable analytics solutions. Your work will span campaign performance, web and mobile analytics, experimentation and dashboard development, enabling marketing teams to optimize investments and improve business outcomes. We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with technical expertise, business curiosity and a passion for turning data into actionable insights. You'll also leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and support smarter decision-making. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e8231952-32d6-.title: Social Media Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e8231952-32d6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Media Manager based in Spain. This is a creative, hands-on opportunity for a social media professional passionate about photography, visual storytelling, and digital culture. You will own social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, helping shape the voice and presence of a globally recognized creative brand. The role combines strategic planning, content creation, performance analysis, and creator collaboration. You will experiment with new formats, trends, and storytelling approaches to discover what resonates with audiences at scale. Your work will directly influence brand awareness, community engagement, and the growth of social channels. You will join a collaborative and flexible environment where creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning are encouraged. This position is ideal for someone with strong visual instincts who enjoys taking ideas from concept through production, publication, and optimization. Develop and own the social media strategy, translating broader brand objectives into engaging, platform-specific content. Define channel strategies for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, including content pillars, editorial calendars, formats, and publishing plans. Identify emerging platform trends, content opportunities, and audience behaviors to keep the social strategy relevant and competitive. Plan, create, edit, and publish high-quality social content aligned with a premium visual identity. Produce short-form videos and other social-first creative assets designed to maximize engagement and audience growth. Continuously improve creative quality by testing new concepts, formats, hooks, storytelling techniques, and visual approaches. Establish performance metrics and reporting processes across social platforms. Monitor content performance, analyze audience behavior, and translate data into actionable recommendations. Run creative experiments and content tests to determine what drives the strongest engagement and growth. Collaborate with photographers, ambassadors, and creators to develop campaigns and compelling community-driven stories. Brief creators on campaigns and content requirements and help curate and repurpose user- and creator-generated content. Manage the social media workflow independently, from ideation and planning through production, publication, analysis, and optimization. Requirements At least 2 years of experience managing social media for a brand. Demonstrated experience growing Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube audiences organically. Strong portfolio showcasing high-performing social media content and creative work. Hands-on experience editing short-form video and producing social-first creative assets. Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of design, composition, and digital content principles. Strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, audience behavior, and platform algorithms. Experience using analytics and performance data to evaluate and improve content strategies. Ability to combine creative thinking with a data-driven and experimentation-focused mindset. Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects from initial concept through publication. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with creators and cross-functional stakeholders. A genuine interest in photography is a strong advantage, whether as a hobby or through professional experience. Familiarity with photo editing tools such as Luminar, Lightroom, Photoshop, or similar software is a plus. Benefits Remote working opportunity, with flexibility around how and where you work. Full-time employment in a creative and collaborative environment. Opportunity to contribute to award-winning photo editing products and a globally recognized visual brand.
